item.title: Enzo Maresca reshuffles Manchester City line-up with nine changes against Brighton
item.description: Manchester City fields a heavily rotated squad for tonight's Carabao Cup fourth round clash against Brighton & Hove Albion.

item.title: League Two Fleetwood Town Stuns Arsenal in Dramatic Carabao Cup Shootout Win
item.description: Fleetwood Town eliminated Arsenal from the Carabao Cup after a 5-3 penalty shootout victory following a 1-1 draw at Highbury Stadium.

item.title: UAE Weather Forecast: Rain to Persist Across Northern and Eastern Regions
item.description: The National Centre of Meteorology predicts rainfall will continue across northern, eastern, and southern UAE for the next five days.

item.title: Chiefs sign veteran kicker Justin Tucker to practice squad after Butker struggles
item.description: The Kansas City Chiefs signed Justin Tucker to their practice squad following Harrison Butker's inconsistent performance during the 2026 NFL season.

item.description: Alexandra Eala defeated 17-year-old wild card Mika Stojsavljevic 6-1, 6-2 in 75 minutes at the Toray Pan Pacific Open.

item.title: RBC blocks third-party AI agents from accessing online banking and client data
item.description: The Royal Bank of Canada is banning external AI tools from its digital properties to protect customer information from unacceptable security risks.

item.title: Brewers Crush Rays 10-1 To Seize Commanding 3-0 World Series Lead
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers moved within one win of their first title by defeating the Tampa Bay Rays 10-1 in Game 3 on Monday.

item.description: Australia enters the second day of the series-deciding Test in Cape Town chasing South Africa's first innings total of 329.

item.title: Aaron Ashby Sets Historic Postseason Scoreless Record During Brewers World Series Loss
item.description: Aaron Ashby established a new MLB record for consecutive scoreless innings by a reliever in a single postseason during Tuesday's 4-3 defeat to the Tampa Bay Rays.

item.title: Milwaukee Brewers Storm to 3-0 World Series Lead Over Tampa Bay Rays
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers move one win away from their first championship after a 10-1 Game 3 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays.

item.title: Milwaukee Brewers One Win From Historic Sweep After Dominating Rays In Game 3
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers hold a 3-0 World Series lead over the Tampa Bay Rays entering Tuesday's Game 4 at Tropicana Field.

item.title: Brewers reach 2026 World Series as family remembers iconic voice Bob Uecker
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers have advanced to the 2026 World Series, prompting a public tribute from the family of legendary broadcaster Bob Uecker.

item.title: Milwaukee Brewers Eye First Franchise World Series Title With Game 4 Sweep
item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers send Dustin May to the mound Tuesday night against the Tampa Bay Rays to clinch their first championship.

item.title: Alfonso Ribeiro Denies Dancing With The Stars Rigging Claims After Podcast Comments
item.description: Host Alfonso Ribeiro rejected allegations that show eliminations are fixed after former contestants suggested producers influence final results.

item.title: Shorthanded Kings face grim odds as defending champions Spurs host Tuesday tilt
item.description: The winless Sacramento Kings travel to face the San Antonio Spurs this Tuesday while struggling with four key players ruled out due to injury.

item.title: Winless Nets Storm TD Garden Seeking Upset Against Reigning Atlantic Division Champions
item.description: The Boston Celtics host the Brooklyn Nets at 7:30 p.m. ET as the home team looks to keep the visitors winless on the season.

item.title: Arsenal faces League Two Fleetwood Town in Carabao Cup fourth round clash
item.description: Arsenal travels 250 miles northwest to face Fleetwood Town tonight in a last-16 Carabao Cup encounter.

item.description: Mitchell Starc took six wickets on day one of the third Test as Australia bowled out South Africa for 329 in Cape Town.

item.title: Sri Lanka Routs Pakistan by Eight Wickets to Secure Tri-Series Final Spot
item.description: Sri Lanka defeated Pakistan by eight wickets in Lahore on Tuesday, eliminating England from the tri-series final contention.

item.title: United flight forced back to Las Vegas after passenger threatens to hijack
item.description: A 25-year-old man was arrested after writing he would hijack a flight and crash it, forcing a return to Las Vegas on Saturday.

item.title: Shoppers clear shelves of tinned food and torches after government stockpile warning
item.description: Supermarkets report massive surges in sales of emergency essentials after the Defence Secretary advised the public to prepare for potential national crises.

item.title: South Africa and Australia clash at Newlands in final Test series decider
item.description: South Africa and Australia meet in the third Test at Newlands starting October 27 with the series level at 1-1.

item.title: Alexandra Eala Routs Mika Stojsavljevic in Tokyo to Reach Second Round
item.description: Alexandra Eala advanced at the Toray Pan Pacific Open after defeating Mika Stojsavljevic 6-1, 6-2 on Monday.

item.title: India eyes series clinching victory as injury-hit New Zealand faces 2-0 deficit
item.description: India aims to secure the five-match T20I series against New Zealand today in Wellington after establishing a 2-0 lead.

item.title: Second cold front brings wet and windy conditions across New Zealand
item.description: MetService expects a second weather front to move up the South Island tomorrow, bringing rain and stronger winds.

item.title: NFL Spotter and Broadcaster David Moulton Dies Following Six-Year Cancer Battle

item.description: The Milwaukee Brewers face the Tampa Bay Rays in Game 3 of the 2026 World Series on Monday night at Tropicana Field.

item.title: Suns Clash With Depleted Thunder Following Jalen Williams' Gruesome Leg Injury
item.description: The Phoenix Suns face the Oklahoma City Thunder on Monday at 7 p.m. CT while the hosts battle a string of significant injuries.

item.title: Packers safety Xavier McKinney slams NFL officiating after controversial Detroit Lions defeat

item.title: PSG looks for first Monday win while Lyon eyes past success

item.title: Alexandra Eala chases breakthrough performance during first trip to Tokyo tournament

item.description: Severe gale winds across New Zealand have triggered orange weather warnings, causing flight disruptions and road closures through Tuesday morning.

item.title: Simba Faces Potential Licence Cancellation Over Alleged Intentional Radio Spectrum Misuse

item.title: October Hunter Moon glows orange as it reaches peak illumination this weekend
item.description: The October full moon reaches 100% illumination just after midnight on Monday, October 26, following its orange-tinted rise at sunset.

item.title: Former Canucks Captain Quinn Hughes Returns To Vancouver For First Time Sunday
item.description: The Minnesota Wild defenseman visits his former home rink at Rogers Arena following his trade last December.

item.title: Barcelona and Real Madrid clash in crucial El Clasico title race
item.description: Barcelona faces Real Madrid this Sunday in a decisive match that could effectively end the La Liga title race.

item.title: Surging Panthers host struggling Buccaneers in divisional clash
item.description: The Carolina Panthers, ranked first in the NFC South at 3-2 with back-to-back wins, face the Tampa Bay Buccaneers at 1-5 on October 25, 2026 at 1:00 PM EDT in Charlotte.

item.title: Dolphins seek first win against Jets in AFC East bottom-two clash
item.description: The Miami Dolphins, winless through five games, travel to MetLife Stadium to face the New York Jets (2-4) on Sunday at 1 p.m. ET in an NFL Week 7 matchup.
